name: cc-router
description: Tiered model routing for Claude Code: plan / build / grunt tiers, quota-aware step-down, scout-first recon.

plan_model.title: Plan tier model
plan_model.description: Model alias or full ID for architecture, plans and deep review (default: opus).

build_model.title: Build tier model
build_model.description: Model alias or full ID for implementation, review and research (default: sonnet).

grunt_model.title: Grunt tier model
grunt_model.description: Model alias or full ID for search, recon and mechanical edits (default: haiku).

warn_at.title: Warn at (% of quota window)
warn_at.description: Tell you when the 5-hour or 7-day window passes this percentage (default: 70).

degrade_at.title: Step down at (% of quota window)
degrade_at.description: Route every tier one step cheaper above this percentage (default: 85).

guard_enabled.title: Scout guard
guard_enabled.description: When the main session is on the plan model, block unbounded searches once and suggest the scout (default: on).
